status: post-hoc exploratory (Amendment 24.1); never confirmatory; never Table 1/2; never the headline sentence

inputs.endpoint: primary (prefilling, persona, many_shot); crisis excluded, never pooled (Amendment 13)

test.name: McNemar's exact test (two-sided), conditional binomial over discordant pairs; p = min(1, 2*min(P(X<=c), P(X>=c))), X ~ Binomial(n_d, 1/2)

method.power: exact enumeration of Binomial(n_d=56, p) over the rejection region; discordant rate held at observed 56/180; raw marginal difference delta maps to split p = 1/2 + delta*n/(2*n_d)
method.mde: bisection to smallest delta with power >= 0.80 (tol 1e-4 pts); deterministic (no RNG in the primary method)
method.cross_check: unconditional simulation, n_d ~ Bin(180, 56/180), n_sim=100000, seed=0
method.scale: raw observed scale (Amendment 22.3: attenuation correction NOT APPLIED)

small_cell_rule: any denominator < 10 gets counts only, no percentage; all denominators here (56, 180) are >= 10
